version.changelog:
- Initial release of figma-code-optimizer
- Generates high-quality front-end code from Figma designs
- Reuses existing project component library and follows design tokens/rules
- Produces maintainable, production-ready code; avoids hardcoded values and deep nesting
- Requires Figma MCP setup and well-structured Figma files for optimal results

vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: figma-code-optimizer
Version: 1.0.0

The skill bundle is a well-structured set of instructions and reference materials designed to help an AI agent generate React code from Figma designs. It includes detailed design tokens (references/design-tokens.txt), component mapping rules (references/component-library.txt), and clear workflow instructions (SKILL.md) that align perfectly with its stated purpose without any indicators of data exfiltration, malicious execution, or harmful prompt injection.

llm.summary: This is an instruction-only Figma→React code-generation skill that is internally consistent with its stated purpose and does not request extra credentials or install code.

dimensions.detail: Name and description (generate code from Figma following a design system) match the instructions and included reference docs. The SKILL.md focuses on mapping Figma frames to project components and tokens, which is exactly what the skill claims to do.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions are limited to: fetching the selected Frame via an MCP connection, extracting styles/variants/layout, mapping to component/token rules, and producing code. The instructions do not ask the agent to read unrelated system files, exfiltrate data, or contact unknown endpoints beyond the user's Figma MCP.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: There is no install spec and no code files executed by the platform; this is instruction-only, which keeps installation risk minimal.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The SKILL.md expects access to a Figma MCP server (official or alternate) to fetch design data. The skill metadata does not declare specific env vars/credentials — this is reasonable if the platform supplies the user's Figma connector, but the user should confirm the agent will use their existing Figma authorization rather than requiring additional secrets to be supplied to the skill.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always is false and the skill does not request persistent system privileges or modify other skills. Autonomous invocation is permitted (platform default) but not combined with other red flags.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill is instruction-only and appears coherent for generating design-system-aware React code from selected Figma frames. Before enabling it: (1) confirm your agent's Figma connector/MCP is authorized (the skill expects to read selected frames via MCP); (2) provide or review the component-library and design-token documents you want it to follow (the skill maps Figma elements to your library based on those docs); (3) be careful not to paste secrets or private tokens into prompts — the skill itself doesn't request credentials, but the agent will use whatever Figma connection is available; (4) review generated code for correctness, security, and accessibility before deploying. If you want to limit risk, invoke the skill manually rather than allowing broad autonomous runs.
